documents.title: Statement on Guidance for the University of Pennsylvania Community on Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence
documents.quality_note: Penn's university-wide guidelines on generative AI: transparency, accountability, bias, privacy, security, IP, with citation per the Code of Academic Integrity.

documents.unit: Center for Excellence in Teaching, Learning and Innovation (CETLI)
documents.title: Creating AI Policies
documents.quality_note: Teaching-center guidance: Penn has no standard student-AI policy and each instructor sets one; syllabus and assignment policy examples; privacy and Penn-licensed tools.

notes: No SEAS or Computer and Information Science department AI policy found (cis.upenn.edu/current-students has 2 AI mentions, not a policy). Known URLs were CIS 1100/1200 course pages (deferred). The CETLI hub (cetli.upenn.edu/resources/generative-ai/) overlaps the collected page and was not kept.
